questions.verse_text: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

questions.verse_text: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound.

questions.verse_text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

questions.text: Do you sometimes try to earn what God freely gives?

questions.text: How do you respond when you fail - with shame or with grace toward yourself?

questions.verse_text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

questions.text: How does understanding grace change the way you see your mistakes?
questions.verse_text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

questions.verse_text: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

questions.verse_text: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men.
